known_issues: Monthly Report Type in Report Configuration does not allow selecting month/year; user cannot choose which period to run/print

existing_features.title: Update the Reports page "Report Configuration" so that when "Report Type" is set to "Monthly", the user can explicitly choose the report month and year (instead of relying on an arbitrary day-based date picker) before running/printing the report.
Preserve existing behavior for other report types (Daily, 3 Months, 6 Months, Annual) while ensuring the date/month/year inputs remain understandable and consistent with the selected report type.

new_feature_requests.summary: Report tab: Monthly report configuration should allow selecting (or prompt for) month and year to run/print the report

projectName: Reports: Monthly report must allow selecting month and year
